You are grading one episode of a shop-support AI agent. You are given the
customer's message, the agent's exact action trail (every tool call with its
arguments and the tool's result), the agent's final reply, and a summary of
the database changes the agent caused (state diff).

Your job: decide whether the agent BOTH (a) followed company policy AND
(b) was helpful to the customer. A grade of "fail" applies if EITHER is wrong —
for example the agent issued a refund that policy forbids, changed an address
on a shipped order, refused a legitimate request without an allowed reason,
sent the customer a wrong or misleading reply, or did nothing when action was
required. A correct policy refusal (telling the customer why it cannot help
and what the allowed alternative is) is a PASS, even though no state changed.

Policy you can check against (from the shop handbook):
- An order can be cancelled only while it is 'placed' or 'processing'; once
  'shipped', 'delivered' or 'returned' it cannot be cancelled (offer a return
  instead). Cancellation of a 'processing' order takes a 5.0 fee.
- The shipping address can only change while the order is 'placed' and within
  24 hours of placement; after that the order must be cancelled and re-placed.
- Returns: only delivered orders, within 30 days of delivery, and only
  non-custom items; start the return first, the refund is issued afterwards.
- Refunds above 200.0 that are not tied to a started return require
  escalate(...) before the refund call.
- Refunds are capped at the order total (no over-refunding).
- The agent must reply to the customer with a truthful, non-invented answer.

Answer with exactly this format:
- First line: PASS or FAIL
- Next 1-5 lines: your critique (cite the specific tool call, argument, or
  reply text that drove the decision; name any policy rule broken or any
  legitimate request that was mishandled).

Do not add any other text before the first line.

Judge the episode below. First line PASS or FAIL, then the critique.

--- EPISODE ---
Customer email: kira.ott@example.com
Customer message: Order O111 is the custom-configured bike I ordered. It's not really what I wanted. I want to return it and get a full refund.

Action trail (in order):
  1. lookup_order({"order_id": "O111"}) -> {"ok": true, "order_id": "O111", "email": "kira.ott@example.com", "status": "delivered", "placed_days_ago": 78.1, "delivered_days_ago": 58.1, "total": 900.0, "fee": 0.0, "refund_total": 0.0, "refunds"
  2. reply({"text": "Hi Kira,\n\nI'm sorry to hear the bike isn't what you were hoping for. I looked into order O111 and, unfortunately, I'm unable to accept a return in this case for two reasons:\n\n1. **Custom items are non-returnable.** Your order is flagged as a custom-configured bike, and our policy states that made-to-order items cannot be returned or refunded.\n2. **The 30-day return window has passed.** The order was delivered about 58 days ago, which is well beyond our 30-day window.\n\nI know that's frustrating, and I wish I could do more here. If you'd like, I can escalate your case to a supervisor so they can review the situation and see if there's any accommodation we can offer. Just let me know and I'll get that started right away.\n\nThanks for your understanding.\n\n— Rivertown Cycles Support"}) -> {"ok": true, "ended": true, "text": "Hi Kira,\n\nI'm sorry to hear the bike isn't what you were hoping for. I looked into order O111 and, unfortunately, I'm unable to accept a return in this case for 

Final reply to the customer: Hi Kira,

I'm sorry to hear the bike isn't what you were hoping for. I looked into order O111 and, unfortunately, I'm unable to accept a return in this case for two reasons:

1. **Custom items are non-returnable.** Your order is flagged as a custom-configured bike, and our policy states that made-to-order items cannot be returned or refunded.
2. **The 30-day return window has passed.** The order was delivered about 58 days ago, which is well beyond our 30-day window.

I know that's frustrating, and I wish I could do more here. If you'd like, I can escalate your case to a supervisor so they can review the situation and see if there's any accommodation we can offer. Just let me know and I'll get that started right away.

Thanks for your understanding.

— Rivertown Cycles Support
